title: Deposit Volume Credit, Restore-Day Extensions — Domain Registrations
content:
**Domain Registrations — account credit volume terms for restore-day extensions**

The restore-day volume credit, one of the restore-day credits, depends on how much the customer has deposited into the account credit of their Harborline Customer Accounts account over the last 12 whole months.

> The restore-day volume credit is USD 0.50 for each restore-day year where the account credit deposits posted on the customer's account less than 12 whole months before the day of the order total USD 5000.00 or more, USD 0.25 for each restore-day year where they total at least USD 250.00 but less than USD 5000.00, and nothing where they total less, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached.

| Deposits posted in the window | Credit |
|---|---|
| USD 5000.00 or more | USD 0.50 for each restore-day year |
| from USD 250.00 up to USD 4999.99 | USD 0.25 for each restore-day year |
| below USD 250.00 | nothing |

**The window.** The deposits counted are those posted fewer than 12 whole months before the day of the order. Hypothetically, for an order on 8 January 2029, a deposit posted on 9 January 2028 counts (11 whole months), while one posted on 8 January 2028 does not (12 whole months).

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).**
- Deposits totalling exactly USD 5000.00 in the window, 5 restore-day years: USD 2.50.
- Deposits totalling USD 4999.99, 5 restore-day years: USD 1.25.
- Deposits totalling exactly USD 250.00, 2 restore-day years: USD 0.50.
- Deposits totalling USD 249.99: nothing.
